goal: Test Guix release binaries continuously in CI instead of waiting for manual builds or release time
Catch broken build manifests, codesign dependencies, and toolchain bugs before changes merge
reviewability: Reviewing now is worthwhile with no blocking issues
agreement: Strong support for catching build and release issues early in CI (fanquake)
Withdrew objections after author agreed to drop the problematic commit (hebasto)
Confirmed no objection after suggesting running tests on the binaries (maflcko)

categories.name: build
why: P2 because testing release packages continuously catches manifest and toolchain regressions early
Compiling in a release context catches issues currently missed and validates static toolchain work

categories.name: tests
why: P3 because running the existing test suite on Guix binaries verifies release package behavior
Drives existing test machinery on release archives rather than expanding test framework capabilities
